instructions.text: Heat the oven to 180 C fan. Cook buckwheat according to its packet and spinach according to its pack; drain the buckwheat and squeeze spinach very dry.
Soften onion in the oil for 5 minutes.
Whisk eggs, cottage cheese, milk, dill, nutmeg, salt and pepper, then fold in buckwheat, spinach and onion.
Spread in a lined shallow baking dish, crumble feta on top and bake for 25-30 minutes until fully set at the centre.
Rest for 10 minutes before slicing into equal portions.

recipes.freezerNotes: Freeze the cooked main component without fresh salad or cold dairy toppings for up to 2 months for best quality. Thaw in the fridge and reheat once.
